introduction: Rhode Island Medicaid provides health coverage under several eligibility categories. RIte Care is a managed-care program for qualifying families and children.
description: Rhode Island Medicaid provides health coverage under several eligibility categories. RIte Care is a managed-care program for qualifying families and children.

sections.who: Income, age, household circumstances and the coverage category affect eligibility. RIte Care includes qualifying families with children, pregnant participants and children younger than 19.
sections.get: Approved coverage helps pay for health services. Review the program and plan assigned in the decision.
sections.docs:

  • Income and any category-specific resource evidence.
  • Current insurance and requested status or disability information.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Create an account at HealthyRhode or download the DHS application.

  2. Use paper intake if preferred

    Mail the completed form to DHS, P.O. Box 8709, Cranston, RI 02920-8787, or use a DHS secure drop box.

  3. Complete verification

    Respond to requested evidence and read the coverage notice.
sections.after: Keep contact information current and complete renewal requests. Ask the plan about providers and covered services.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using State Medicaid application; RIte Care. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
